wire-shape divergence: process/hostcalls.go's decodeHostParam(n.Params, "domain") checks only the storage DOMAIN, never key existence -- it has no equivalent to the wasm ABI's op/key/value StorageRequest shape at all. So this fixture's wasm/builtin error (a real not-found on a missing key) and its process denial (an ungranted domain) are genuinely different real causes, not the same check exercised twice; forcing them to share one cause would misrepresent what process actually verifies.
